content: Rechoka Te Katosol Chol Foloy

Rechoka te katosol profeta le re budoh luwulur yarmat muswe, ila be wol ila sengal yar budoh rechoka te katosol chol foloy luwulumi. Re bele hasidoh foloy kala yar le te katos ngo yebe hasidoh tayikof. Iwe ngo re bele hasi bo re togla Masta we iy mele ye demerir, ila bele ir chog yar hasi ngalir hagerger.
Ila mwo ngo ye cholop rechokla re bele dabey mekla wegdigir le ye tayikof. Ngo fael mekla re foforu mele bele yor le yebe hapatpat tayikof loh irel mala yalol Deus le ye katos.

Bele yoh ngalir salpiy luwul yar chehaw mo irel foloy kala yar ngalugmi le yete katos. Deus le iy mele Re Tatelael Hapatpat ila ye faesul fel. Iwe ngo Deus le iy mele yebe fang yar hagerger ila ye tema masor.
Deus ye hagrer angelus kowe re molfid, le ye ppedir long Infiyerno re sala chen luwul ruchupung rebe widiy ralla Ral Tatelal Hapatpat.
Deus ye hagrer yarmat muswe. Ye foru le be burloh talop le iwe re sala rol mes loh. Hala chog Noah we yema foloyu ngalir yarmat mekla Deus ye dipli rebe foru iwe mo fismol yarmat, mele re molow.
Deus mele ye foru bo rebe mesloh yarmetael Sodom mo Gomorrah le ye fisgi haplom kowe ngal yaef, ngo ye foru bo yebe kawraloh le be ila sengal mala yebe wel ngalir rechokla rete chepar irel Deus.
Deus ye hadora Lot we iy semal mal le ye momay, ngo ye tayikof loh chog depal irel wegdeg tayikof kowe yarmat re foforu.
Mal le ye momay ila ye mel luwulur lebong mo lerael yal tayikof loh chog depal irel yal rongrong ngo ye wiri wegdeg tayikof kowe yar yarmat.
Iwe ngo Samol ye gola igegel yal be hadorar rechoka re momay mo luwul weres, ngo ye yitlir chog rechokla re tayikof luwul hagerger yee, yela hola ralla Ral Tatelal Hapatpat.

Rechoka yebe palleng yar hagerger ila rechokla resa dedabey chog wegdegel maltemay, mo wegdeg tayikof kala yar, ngo re tolpagili loh mala yalol Deus. Rechokla te katosol chol foloy ila tor mele re metagu, ngo re hattamol, ngo retema hasrowu rechokla wol laeng, bo rema hapatpat tayikof loh irer.
Angelus kala mwo woal laeng le re kel ngo re tagiyet mo imor rechoka te katos foloy ka yar, ngo re tema sor derer hare re hapatpat tayikof irer mo fael metael Samol.

Iwe ngo rechokla ila re wochog mael machoh kowe re subdoh bo yarmat rebe ddorfir resa llir; ngo rema hapatpat tayikof irel pangal formel le re togla kofal. Ir ila rebe mes le rebe wochog yar mes maelka re machoh.

Iwe ngo ir ila rebe hafohoy bo paliyel yar hafohoyur yarmat. Mekla depel halngor ila rema foru lal werloh bo ikla mekla yema fel deper iyang. Ye hamama mala rema dabohmi irel mongoy bo ir re dipli wegdeg tayikof kala rema foru.

Mekla chog rema luwaley ila, mala rebe pere ril semal. Ngo tema chuy deper mo irel ffaorol molfid. Iwe ngo rema palirloh rechoka tayikel yar tugul luwul molfid, iwe ngo chehaw sa lamlirloh, ila Deus yebe fang yar hagerger.
Resa ligdi yalap la ye wwel re sala mwael loh. Iwe resa dabey yalap we Balaam we lol Beor ye dabey. Balaam we ye chahewal salpiy le yebe yoh ngali mo irel meka ye tayikof le ma foru.
Donkey we lol mele ye malili loh yesa kkaftoroy ngali ngo ye hapolaho mo irel molfid kowe ye foforu.
Rechoka ila re wochog mololul kowe yesa morloh chael mo iyang, iwe mo darmiy kowe yaeng ma ffildaloh. Deus yesa faesul hafle chog solbos mo lal Infiyerno bo liliyer rechoka.
Rema hapatpatael habos ngo re tapeli wegdeg tayikof kala yar bo rebe kacheprar rechokla resa luluwaley bo rebe chuy mo luwulur ikala re mel luwul machey kala yar.
Rema hatugulu ngalir yarmat bo re bele mel luwul taldag. Iwe ngo ir ila re mel luwul lofidfidil tayikof kala yar. Bo gich yarmat ila sima mel bo slave irel pangal meka yema lamligich loh.

Bo hare yarmat resa chuy tang kelel molfid ka lal talop le mo irel yar gola Samol mo Demer we yach Jesus Kristus, ngo re sala tefael ngal molfid kowe re faesul foforadoh ngo tappilir rechokla, ila yesa kel tot yar tayikof tangi molwe metamo.
Ye far momay le re togla mala ye fel ngo ye katos, mo imol mala rebe gola ngo resa tagul tang hatobtob ka ye santus le yesa yoh ngalir.

Mala ye wel ngalir ila ye halleha loh le mokwe ye mel lal proverbs, ila ye katos: “Semal pes yema tefael ngal mokwe sa mmutagili loh” iwe ngo “Semal pabiy kowe resa hadudu, ila yema tefael loh tapolpol fedal luwul mochor.”
